decisions.statement: A call naming one domain beside `--all` is refused.
A call naming no domain and saying no `--all` is refused.
A domain the addon's registry does not have is refused by name.
The request is a version number the addon weighs against the last version seen.
The collection happens when the game next reloads.
A folder this made where the game reads addons is named as soon as it is made.
A write that threw names that folder in its refusal.
A call that made no folder says nothing about one.
The writing of the request is handed in.

definition: the command telling the catalog addon to collect the named domains again
